training_reference.scope: Single-stage flat skill continuation with adaptive per-signed-group command frontiers; source mechanisms are independently audited, not assumed enabled in SCUT Flat
training_reference.schedule: 13000 actual updates at 6144 environments, one shared actor and optimizer after initial critic warmup, all flat skill families present throughout
training_reference.rehearsal: Balanced fixed group quotas; adaptive within-group easy/frontier mixture and a nonzero full-domain probe quota
training_reference.height_distribution: Parallel episode-held target heights dominate; 60% nominal motion heights, 20% endpoints and 20% uniform range; explicit height profiles and a minority of moving transitions remain represented
training_reference.height_shape: Fixed original narrow kernel and quadratic plus V5.4 wide companion; no monotonic sigma annealing
training_reference.stage_transfer: Actor from checkpoint e6307dd7419c052a96285e58ce6a6624b8832e6c5986aadf568287bfcfc37f81, 12486 source updates; fresh critic/optimizer, fixed 3e-5, 50 critic warmup updates
training_reference.regression: Fixed 59-case evaluation selects policies and protects seven independently reverified anchors; no skill-unlocking macro stage gates
training_reference.recovery: Persist command caps, sampling fractions, revisions and completed episode windows; discard partial simulator episodes on same-contract resume
training_reference.causality: Test task distribution and performance-driven command progression; PD, friction, auxiliary forces, reward kernels and actor architecture are not simultaneously annealed
training_reference.future_scope: Landing, active jump, terrain and perturbation extensions require a subsequent contract after this flat policy is accepted
